purpose: Manage traceable GitHub pull request changes under explicit review gates.

trigger: Open a PR for the completed feature branch in my repository
Check whether the PR for my exact commit passed CI
Merge the reviewed PR after all checks and approval
do_not_trigger: Write a new feature in my local files without GitHub
Summarize a paper about pull request practices

preflight: Resolve the exact repository, branch and head commit; refuse ambiguous targets.
Use a scoped GitHub identity; never extract tokens from .env or git credential stores.
Determine whether the task is branch creation, PR publication, CI monitoring or merge.
workflow: Create a task-specific branch or confirm that the current worktree is isolated.
Verify the exact PR head SHA, expected base and required status contexts.
Never retry a write after an ambiguous remote outcome without read-back.
Report the PR URL, observed head, check outcomes and any unresolved blocks.

evidence.how_to_verify: Read back the exact PR head SHA and compare to intended revision.
Independently read the target PR URL, number, base and current state.
Required check conclusions must be successful at the same SHA.
Owner approves the exact PR number and head SHA before merge.

failure_modes: Missing required check is blocked, never treated as success.
Unknown push/merge response must be reconciled by remote read-back.
